title: feat: extract core providers and hooks to @object-ui/app-shell
body:
Extracts reusable console infrastructure from `apps/console` into `@object-ui/app-shell`, enabling third-party projects to build custom consoles with ~200 lines instead of 34k lines.

## Extracted Components

**Providers** (data layer infrastructure):
- `AdapterProvider` + `useAdapter` - ObjectStack adapter connection management
- `MetadataProvider` + `useMetadata` - Lazy-loading metadata cache (apps, objects, dashboards, reports, pages)
- `ExpressionProvider` + `useExpressionContext` - Expression evaluation context for dynamic visibility/disabled conditions

**Hooks** (application logic):
- `useObjectActions` - CRUD operation handlers (create, delete, navigate, refresh)
- `useRecentItems` - Recently visited items tracking with localStorage persistence

## Package Structure

```
@object-ui/app-shell/
├── components/       # UI renderers (existing)
├── providers/        # Core providers (new)
│   ├── AdapterProvider.tsx
│   ├── MetadataProvider.tsx
│   └── ExpressionProvider.tsx
└── hooks/           # Common hooks (new)
    ├── useObjectActions.ts
    └── useRecentItems.ts
```

## Usage Example

Third-party projects can now compose a custom console:

```typescript
import { 
  AdapterProvider, 
  MetadataProvider, 
  ExpressionProvider,
  useRecentItems,
  useObjectActions 
} from '@object-ui/app-shell';

function CustomConsole() {
  return (
    <AdapterProvider>
      <MetadataProvider>
        <ExpressionProvider user={user} app={app}>
          <YourCustomLayout />
        </ExpressionProvider>
      </MetadataProvider>
    </AdapterProvider>
  );
}
```

## Changes

- **Added** providers and hooks directories to `@object-ui/app-shell`
- **Updated** `package.json` dependencies: added `@object-ui/auth`, `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, `sonner`, `react-router-dom` (peer)
- **Updated** TypeScript project references to include new workspace dependencies
- **Migrated** all console imports from local paths to `@object-ui/app-shell` package (20+ files)
- **Fixed** import paths to use `@object-ui/data-objectstack` instead of local `dataSource` module

## Breaking Changes

None. Console continues to work identically, now importing from `@object-ui/app-shell` instead of local context/hooks directories.
